title: A SURVEY OF CREATING A BOARD GAME BASED ON THE ALICE IN BORDERLAND
author: Pleasant_Bend_7837
selftext:
Hello everyone,

We are currently working on a school project where we are designing a **board game inspired by** ***Alice in Borderland***. To ensure the game is both engaging and enjoyable, we would greatly appreciate your input.

We have prepared a survey to collect ideas, opinions, and preferences from fans like you. Your feedback will help us identify our target audience and make sure the game includes all the right elements.

👉 **SURVEY LINK** [https://thomasmore.questionpro.eu/OKAAYSTUDIOSSURVEY](https://thomasmore.questionpro.eu/OKAAYSTUDIOSSURVEY) (the link is completely safe ✅)

Thank you very much for your time and support — every response is valuable and will significantly contribute to the success of our project. 🙏
